title: benchhand policy provider contribution, provisional
description: Provisional: what one policy provider adds to the flow (ADR-0014): rule-list files, by kind, in the shape of flow/rules.schema.json, and CEL requirements for the gates of flow.yaml. Each file is relative to the provider's root. The lists of one kind are evaluated in a fixed order: the contributions in ascending provider name, then flow.yaml's own list. For checks_by_iteration, dispatch and fidelity the first list whose output isn't the kind's no-match value gives the value; the no-match values are [], "unknown" and "none", and a contributed list ends with its kind's. For rigor every list must give true. A gate's contributed requirements must hold as well as flow.yaml's, and are checked after them in the same provider order. A requirement for a step the gate doesn't have, or for a gate flow.yaml doesn't declare, is refused when the flow loads. The owner has yet to confirm this order
